import ratelimiter
from ratelimiter import RateLimiter


def test_invalid_capacity():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RateLimiter(0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RateLimiter(-3, 1)


def test_invalid_refill():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        RateLimiter(5, -0.5)


def test_zero_refill_allowed():
    rl = RateLimiter(2, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(1000) is True
    assert rl.allow(2000) is False


def test_starts_full():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 5.0


def test_tokens_returns_float_when_full():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    assert isinstance(rl.tokens(0), float)


def test_first_call_no_refill_and_sets_reference():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 1)
    assert rl.allow(100, cost=10) is True
    assert rl.tokens(100) == 0.0
    assert rl.tokens(104) == 4.0


def test_allow_consumes_tokens():
    rl = RateLimiter(3, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is False


def test_cost_exactly_available():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=5) is True
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 0.0


def test_cost_exceeds_tokens_takes_nothing():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=6) is False
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 5.0


def test_denied_allow_takes_nothing():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 0)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=5) is True
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=1) is False
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 0.0


def test_refill_over_time():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 2)
    rl.allow(0, cost=10)
    assert rl.tokens(1) == 2.0
    assert rl.tokens(3) == 6.0


def test_fractional_refill():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 1)
    rl.allow(0, cost=10)
    assert rl.tokens(0.5) == 0.5
    assert rl.allow(0.5) is False
    assert rl.allow(1.0) is True


def test_refill_capped_at_capacity():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 10)
    rl.allow(0, cost=5)
    assert rl.tokens(1000) == 5.0


def test_denied_allow_still_refills():
    rl = RateLimiter(4, 1)
    assert rl.allow(0, cost=4) is True
    assert rl.allow(1, cost=2) is False
    assert rl.tokens(1) == 1.0
    assert rl.tokens(2) == 2.0
    assert rl.allow(2, cost=2) is True


def test_invalid_cost():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(0, cost=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(0, cost=-1)


def test_time_backwards_allow():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    rl.allow(5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(4)


def test_time_backwards_tokens():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    rl.tokens(5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.tokens(4.9)


def test_same_time_ok():
    rl = RateLimiter(5, 1)
    rl.allow(5)
    assert rl.allow(5) is True
    assert rl.tokens(5) == 3.0


def test_state_valid_after_backwards_error():
    rl = RateLimiter(10, 1)
    rl.allow(5, cost=10)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rl.allow(1)
    assert rl.tokens(7) == 2.0


def test_capacity_one_is_valid():
    rl = RateLimiter(1, 0)
    assert rl.tokens(0) == 1.0
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0) is False


def test_capacity_one_refills_to_cap():
    rl = RateLimiter(1, 1)
    assert rl.allow(0) is True
    assert rl.allow(0.5) is False
    assert rl.allow(1) is True
    assert rl.tokens(100) == 1.0
